listing.name: Sprog's Quickships
listing.summary: Adds custom heavy capital ships with unique weapon loadouts.

description: Introduces new vessels such as the Ark Royal, a powerful but vulnerable heavy capital ship. These ships feature specialized armaments like assault chainguns and hellbore cannons.
